## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or requirement.

## Verification

List exact commands and their passed, failed, skipped or unavailable outcomes, with
reasons. Distinguish CPU/static checks from GPU or cluster runs and name the tested
source/artifact identity. Do not include private credentials, paths, cluster
identities, audio or transcripts.

Use the [code review checklist](https://github.com/swimmwatch/openwhispr-whisper-server/blob/main/docs/code-review.md); rendering and test skips
are not runtime qualification.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] Scope and architecture match the approved requirements.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; failed or unavailable checks are disclosed.
- [ ] No credentials, private audio/transcripts, models or generated output are included.
- [ ] Third-party notices remain accurate.
- [ ] User-facing changes include accurate documentation; no unsupported qualification claims.
- [ ] I have read [Contributing](https://github.com/swimmwatch/openwhispr-whisper-server/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [Code of conduct](https://github.com/swimmwatch/openwhispr-whisper-server/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
